title: Intended Use
text:
The OralEye Oral Imaging System is a portable, non-invasive imaging device designed for capturing high-resolution intraoral images using visible and fluorescence imaging modalities.



The OralEye system is intended for:

Capturing intraoral photographs for diagnostic purposes
Documenting oral conditions and treatment progress
Patient education and communication
Integration with digital patient records





Age Range: All ages
Conditions: General oral health screening and documentation
Contraindications: None known





Enhanced visualization of oral structures
Improved patient communication
Comprehensive documentation
Support for treatment planning




The device is indicated for use in dental practice settings for capturing and storing intraoral images to assist in:

Clinical examination
Diagnosis and treatment planning
Patient record documentation
Patient education




There are no known contraindications for use of this device when used as directed.









Warning




This device is prescription-use only and should be operated by trained dental professionals
Not intended for use as the sole basis for diagnosis
Images should be interpreted by qualified dental professionals







Type: Intraoral camera system
Modalities:

Visible light reflectance imaging
Fluorescence imaging

Portability: Handheld, battery-operated


For complete safety information, see Safety Information

title: Safety Information
text:
ImportantCritical Safety Information



Read and understand all safety information before using the OralEye system. Failure to follow these instructions may result in injury or device damage.








Use only the provided power adapter
Do not expose the device to liquids
Disconnect power before cleaning
Do not use if power cord is damaged





Ensure patient comfort during imaging procedures
Avoid prolonged LED exposure to eyes
Use appropriate infection control procedures
Follow standard precautions for patient contact





LED light source is safe for intended use
Do not stare directly into LED array
Automatic exposure control prevents overexposure








Barrier Protection: Use disposable barriers for intraoral components
Surface Disinfection: Clean all surfaces with approved disinfectant after each patient
Hand Hygiene: Follow standard hand hygiene protocols





Isopropyl alcohol (70%)
EPA-registered hospital-grade disinfectants
Follow manufacturer’s contact time recommendations







Warning



Do not autoclave or immerse device in liquid. Do not use abrasive cleaners.









Temperature: 15°C to 30°C (59°F to 86°F)
Humidity: 30% to 75% relative humidity
Pressure: 700 hPa to 1060 hPa





Temperature: -10°C to 50°C (14°F to 122°F)
Humidity: 10% to 90% relative humidity (non-condensing)








Do not dispose of device in regular waste
Follow local regulations for electronic waste disposal
Contact manufacturer for recycling options





Lithium-ion batteries must be recycled according to local regulations
Contact local waste management for battery recycling





Report adverse events or device problems to:

Manufacturer: support@oraleye.ai
FDA: via MedWatch (1-800-FDA-1088)


This safety information is current as of the document effective date.
